description: A home for tiny experiments, reflex tests, and games that respect your time.
musicCredit: Start page theme “Alien no.1”, UI & gameplay sounds by Ong Yuet Li
creditsDescription: Thanks to the tools and people helping shape this small game universe.

bubble.title: Bubble Trouble
bubble.description: Split every bouncing bubble before it reaches you.
bubble.tutorialMove: Move left and right with {keys} on keyboard, or the on-screen stick.
bubble.tutorialShoot: Fire a rope straight up with {keys} on keyboard, or the on-screen shoot button.
bubble.tutorialSplit: The string splits a bubble when it touches it. Smaller bubbles are worth points too.
bubble.tutorialClear: Clear every bubble to finish. In a real round you survive three hits to win.
bubble.tutorialComplete: Nice work — you are ready to play!
bubble.inspiredBy: Inspired by Bubble Trouble from Miniclip

tron.title: Tron
tron.description: Paint walls of light and outlast your rival in a head-to-head light-cycle duel.
tron.tutorialTurnLeft: Turn left before you hit the wall.
tron.tutorialTurnRight: Turn right to steer clear of your own trail.
tron.tutorialWall: Ride safely along your own light wall, then finish.
tron.tutorialComplete: Nice work — you are ready to play!
tron.inspiredBy: Inspired by the Tron light-cycle genre (1982 film)

pokemonBnb.title: Pokemon TCG B&B mini
pokemonBnb.description: Host a peer lobby, open 30th Celebration packs together, build a limited deck from what you pull, and duel with rulebook-close TCG rules.
pokemonBnb.wip: This part is on the workbench — it arrives in a later checkpoint.
pokemonBnb.inspiredBy: Inspired by the Pokemon TCG Build & Battle limited format
pokemonBnb.tutorialPack: Join a lobby, then open your packs one card at a time — or skip to reveal them all.
pokemonBnb.tutorialDeck: Build your limited deck from the cards you opened. Your deck stays secret until you play it.
pokemonBnb.tutorialBattle: Duel: draw, attach energy, evolve, attack, retreat, and take prize cards when you knock out a Pokemon. Deck out and you lose.
pokemonBnb.tutorialComplete: Nice work — you are ready to play!
pokemonBnb.shareCode: Share this code with the other player.
